PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  25-56903  Recommendation to approve November 6, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57017  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal UD-25-262 for Long Beach
  Utilities Executive Classification and Compensation Study and award a contract to
  The Segal Group, Inc., to provide professional classification and compensation
  consultant services in a total amount not to exceed $75,000 for a period of one
  year, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to
  enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56913  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents to
  amend Contract No. 32400947 with Merrimac Petroleum, Inc. dba Merrimac
  Energy Group of Long Beach, California, for the purchase and delivery of
  petroleum fuels for use in Long Beach Public Utilities Department Water and
  Sewer vehicles and equipment, to increase the aggregate not-to-exceed amount
  for the initial 2-year term from $530,000 to $800,000, and to increase the annual
  not-to-exceed amount from $265,000 to $400,000 for each renewal period.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56914  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Contract No. 32400942 with West Coast Sand & Gravel, Inc.,
  a California corporation, for the purchase and delivery of as-needed sand, gravel,
  and related construction materials, to increase the total not-to-exceed amount from

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  $600,000 to $1,100,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

5.  25-57022  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute any and all
  documents necessary to amend Lease No. WDL-210 with Don Temple Storage,
  LLC, a California Limited Liability Company, to extend the lease of Los Angeles
  County Assessor Parcel 10 and a portion of Parcel 7, through September 30,
  2030, with one five-year extension, and to incrementally increase the monthly rent.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-57023  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1544 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract and any necessary documents, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments, with Partners for Public Good, for technical
  assistance in improving procurement processes in the total amount not to exceed
  $75,000, for a period of one year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56905  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the 10-year Partnership for
  Safe Water President Award.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call
the Board of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-
6626 (telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
